title: Legacy Financial Dashboard Modernization
business: A regional investment firm managing real-time portfolio tracking portals for retail clients.
problem: The firm's legacy build pipeline relies on a monolithic, plugin-heavy configuration that causes deployment delays exceeding twenty minutes, preventing rapid hotfixes for critical market data visualization bugs.
solution: By migrating the build process to esbuild, the firm replaces complex, multi-stage transpilation and minification steps with a unified, high-performance pipeline that handles TypeScript, JSX, and CSS bundling natively without requiring external cache management.
steps: Define the entry point and output directory in a build script using the esbuild JavaScript API.
Enable the minify flag to reduce bundle size for client-side delivery.
Configure sourcemap generation to ensure production errors remain debuggable in the browser.
Integrate the build script into the existing CI/CD pipeline to replace the legacy task runner.
outcome: The development team achieves near-instant feedback loops during local development and significantly reduced CI/CD pipeline duration, allowing for more frequent and reliable deployments of client-facing features.
limitation: Because esbuild prioritizes speed by omitting certain complex type-checking features found in the TypeScript compiler, developers must run the tsc command separately to verify type safety, which can be checked by inspecting the build logs for type errors that esbuild ignores.
